unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces
scanNote:
WORKBOOK 51-BET. Unit 12 — fikr bildirish, taklif qilish, Bostondan xat.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 15-mashq (4 savol), 16-mashq (10 bo'shliq), 17-mashq (jadvalning 11 bandi), 18-mashq (Boston haqida maqola).

⚠⚠ IKKI KITOB XATOSI 15-MAShQDA:
  1) IMLO: kitobda 'the TERRACOTA Army' — bitta 't'. To'g'risi TERRACOTTA (italyancha 'terra cotta' = pishirilgan tuproq). Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim.
  2) GEOGRAFIYA: 'next to the LI RIVER' deyilgan. Terrakota armiyasi SIANDA (Xi'an), Vey daryosi yaqinida; Li daryosi esa Guylinda, undan ~1500 km uzoqda. Ikkala joyning bir-biriga aloqasi yo'q.
  ⚠ Kitob matni asl holida qoldirildi, izohga ogohlantirish yozildi.

⚠ 16-MAShQ — TAKLIF QILISh QOLIPLARI:
  'SHALL we go...?' · 'LET'S go...' · 'WHY DON'T we go...?'
  ⚠ Uchalasi bir xil ma'noda, lekin tuzilishi boshqa: 'shall' va 'why don't' dan keyin EGA keladi, 'let's' dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'l.
  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 8 ibora, bo'shliq 10 ta — 'shall' va 'let's' ikki martadan ishlatiladi.

⚠ 17-MAShQ — XATDAN JADVALGA: barcha Boston joylari tekshirildi va HAQIQIY: Harvard University, Old North Church, Public Gardens, New England Aquarium, Newbury Street (xarid ko'chasi), Filene's Basement (arzon do'kon), The Roxy (tungi klub), Ritz-Carlton va Bertram Inn mehmonxonalari.
  ⚠ Boston haqiqatan AQShning SHARQIY qirg'og'ida va kollejlari bilan mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the questions below to fill in the blanks.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni to'ldirish uchun quyidagi savollardan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta savol, 4 ta bo'shliq):
  What did you see there,
  What was China like,
  Did you enjoy the nightlife,
  What did you think of Chinese food


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WHAT WAS CHINA LIKE?
  B: It was great! There were lots of interesting
     places to visit and excellent shops.

  A: WHAT DID YOU SEE THERE?
  B: We saw the Great Wall of China and the
     Terracotta Army, a group of large statues that
     are the size of real people, next to the Li
     River.

  A: WHAT DID YOU THINK OF CHINESE FOOD?
  B: It was delicious and quite cheap.

  A: DID YOU ENJOY THE NIGHTLIFE?
  B: Yes, very much. We went to some very
     fashionable nightclubs, but the pubs were
     friendlier and not as expensive as the clubs.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Xitoy qanday edi?
  B: Ajoyib edi! Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar
     va a'lo do'konlar ko'p edi.
  A: U yerda nima ko'rdinglar?
  B: Xitoy devorini va Terrakota armiyasini ko'rdik
     — bu haqiqiy odam kattaligidagi katta
     haykallar guruhi, Li daryosi yonida.
  A: Xitoy taomlari haqida nima deb o'ylading?
  B: Mazali va ancha arzon edi.
  A: Tungi hayot senga yoqdimi?
  B: Ha, juda. Biz juda moda tungi klublarga
     bordik, lekin pablar samimiyroq va klublar
     chalik qimmat emas edi.


HAR BIR JAVOB QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1) Javob: 'It was GREAT! There were lots of
     interesting places ...'
     → UMUMIY taassurot → 'What was China LIKE?'
     DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda TASVIRLASh so'raydi.

  2) Javob: 'We SAW the Great Wall ...'
     → KO'RILGAN narsalar → 'What did you SEE
       there?'

  3) Javob: 'It was DELICIOUS and quite cheap.'
     → OVQAT haqida fikr → 'What did you think OF
       Chinese FOOD?'

  4) Javob: 'YES, very much. We went to some very
     fashionable NIGHTCLUBS ...'
     → 'Yes' bilan boshlanadi → HA/YO'Q savoli →
       'DID you enjoy the nightlife?'


DIQQAT — Coursebook 85-BETDAGI 15-MAShQ BILAN
BIR XIL QOLIPLAR:
     'What was ... LIKE?'         (tasvir)
     'What did you THINK OF ...?' (fikr)
     'DID you like/enjoy ...?'    (ha/yo'q)
  Uchala fikr so'rash usuli ham shu dialogda.


JAVOBDAGI GRAMMATIKA (Unit 12 mavzusi):
  'the pubs were FRIENDLIER'
     → QIYOSIY daraja ('-y' → -IER)
  'NOT AS EXPENSIVE AS the clubs'
     → tenglik INKORI


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the Great Wall of China = Xitoy devori
  the Terracotta Army     = Terrakota armiyasi
                            (Xitondagi mashhur
                             haykallar)
  a statue                = haykal
  the size of             = ... kattaligida
  real                    = haqiqiy
  a nightclub             = tungi klub
  a pub                   = pab

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo): kitobda
'the TERRACOTA Army' deb bosilgan — bitta
't' bilan. Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim.

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — TERRACOTTA,
  IKKITA 't' bilan. Bu italyancha so'z
  ('terra cotta' = pishirilgan tuproq).


⚠⚠ GEOGRAFIK XATO: matnda Terrakota armiyasi
'NEXT TO THE LI RIVER' (Li daryosi yonida)
deyilgan.

  ⚠ Bu NOTO'G'RI. Terrakota armiyasi
  SIANDA (Xi'an, Shensi viloyati)
  joylashgan — Vey daryosi yaqinida.

  ⚠ LI DARYOSI esa Guylin shahri yonida,
  Guansi viloyatida — Siandan taxminan
  1500 km uzoqda.

  ⚠ Ikkala joy ham Xitoyda, lekin bir-biriga
  hech qanday aloqasi yo'q.

  ⚠ Li daryosi o'zining tik, yashil
  tog'lari bilan mashhur — xitoy rasmlarida
  ko'p uchraydigan manzara.

  ⚠ Kitob matni asl holida qoldirildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the phrases in the list. You can use some twice.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring. Ba'zilarini IKKI marta ishlatishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora, 10 ta bo'shliq):
  let's, shall, very romantic, more expensive,
  why don't, quite far, the best, most popular

  DIQQAT: 10 bo'shliq, lekin 8 ibora →
  IKKITASI IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi.


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: SHALL we go out on Saturday? It's my birthday.
  B: Great! LET'S go somewhere special.
     WHY DON'T we go to a nice restaurant like
     Tiffany's?
  A: Well, it's the MOST POPULAR place in town, so
     it's always very busy on Saturdays.
  B: Hmm. You're right. Then, LET'S go to the Cave.
     It's VERY ROMANTIC and it's never too crowded.
  A: Yes, but it's very expensive, and it's QUITE
     FAR. We'll need a car.
  B: I know it's MORE EXPENSIVE than many of the
     other places, but it's also more luxurious and
     the food there is THE BEST in town. And I've
     got my dad's car! So, SHALL we go there then?
  A: Okay, let's go to the Cave.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  A: Shanbada sayrga chiqaylikmi? Bu mening
     tug'ilgan kunim.
  B: Zo'r! Kel biror maxsus joyga boraylik.
     Nega 'Tiffany's' kabi yaxshi restoranga
     bormaymiz?
  A: Ha, lekin u shahardagi eng mashhur joy,
     shuning uchun shanbalarda doim juda gavjum.
  B: Hmm. Sen haqsan. Unda kel 'Cave' ga boraylik.
     U juda romantik va hech qachon haddan tashqari
     gavjum bo'lmaydi.
  A: Ha, lekin u juda qimmat va ancha uzoqda.
     Bizga mashina kerak bo'ladi.
  B: Bilaman, u boshqa ko'p joylardan qimmatroq,
     lekin u hashamatliroq ham va u yerdagi ovqat
     shahardagi eng yaxshisi. Va menda dadamning
     mashinasi bor! Xo'sh, unda o'sha yerga
     boraylikmi?
  A: Mayli, kel 'Cave' ga boraylik.


IKKI MARTA IShLATILGANLAR:
  LET'S  →  2-band va 5-band
  SHALL  →  1-band va 10-band


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

   1) '...... we go out on Saturday?'
      → SHALL (taklif savoli)
      'Shall we ...?' — eng muloyim taklif.

   2) 'Great! ...... go somewhere special.'
      → LET'S (taklif, TASDIQ gap)
      'Let's go somewhere special.'

   3) '...... we go to a nice restaurant?'
      → WHY DON'T (taklif savoli)
      'Why don't we ...?'

   4) 'it's the ...... place in town'
      → MOST POPULAR (orttirma daraja)
      'the most popular place IN town'.

   5) 'Then, ...... go to the Cave.'
      → LET'S (ikkinchi marta)

   6) 'It's ...... and it's never too crowded.'
      → VERY ROMANTIC
      'very' + ODDIY sifat.

   7) 'it's very expensive, and it's ...... .'
      → QUITE FAR
      'quite' + ODDIY sifat.
      Keyingi gap tasdiqlaydi: 'We'll need a car.'

   8) 'I know it's ...... than many of the other
      places'
      → MORE EXPENSIVE
      'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.

   9) 'the food there is ...... in town'
      → THE BEST
      'IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
      'good' → THE BEST (noto'g'ri sifat).

  10) 'So, ...... we go there then?'
      → SHALL (ikkinchi marta)
      Yakuniy taklif savoli.


UCh TAKLIF USULI — HAMMASI ShU DIALOGDA
(Coursebook 86-betdagi quti):
     SHALL we ...?        (1, 10-bandlar)
     LET'S ...            (2, 5-bandlar)
     WHY DON'T we ...?    (3-band)


DIQQAT — DARAJALAR:
  most popular   → ORTTIRMA ('the ... in town')
  very romantic  → ODDIY ('very' bilan)
  quite far      → ODDIY ('quite' bilan)
  more expensive → QIYOSIY ('than' bilan)
  the best       → ORTTIRMA ('in town')

  Ya'ni ro'yxatdagi 4 ta sifat iborasi HAR XIL
  darajada — gapdagi kalit so'zga qarab tanlanadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  somewhere special = biror maxsus joy
  far               = uzoq
  luxurious         = hashamatli
  a cave            = g'or (bu yerda restoran nomi)

lines.textEn: 1) ............ we go out on Saturday? It's my birthday.
lines.whyUz:
'SHALL we ...?' — eng muloyim taklif savoli.
Coursebook 86-betdagi taklif qutisidan.
Keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli: 'go'.

'LET'S ...' — taklifning TASDIQ shakli
(savol emas, nuqta bilan tugaydi).
'Let's' = 'let us'.
'somewhere special' — sifat 'somewhere' dan KEYIN.

lines.textEn: 3) ............ we go to a nice restaurant like Tiffany's?
lines.whyUz:
'WHY DON'T we ...?' — taklifning uchinchi usuli.
Savol shaklida, lekin ma'nosi TAKLIF.
'like' bu yerda 'masalan' ma'nosida.

lines.textEn: Well, it's the 4) ............ place in town, so it's always very busy on Saturdays.
lines.whyUz:
'the ... IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'popular' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST POPULAR.
'the' gapda allaqachon bosilgan.

lines.textEn: Hmm. You're right. Then, 5) ............ go to the Cave.
lines.whyUz:
'LET'S ...' — IKKINCHI marta (2-bandda ham edi).
Kitob aytgan: 'You can use some twice.'
Taklifning TASDIQ shakli.

lines.textEn: It's 6) ............ and it's never too crowded.
lines.whyUz:
'VERY ROMANTIC' — 'very' + ODDIY sifat.
QIYOSLASH YO'Q.
Grammar 52-bet: 'very' + oddiy sifat.

lines.textEn: Yes, but it's very expensive, and it's 7) ............ . We'll need a car.
lines.whyUz:
'QUITE FAR' — 'quite' + ODDIY sifat.
Keyingi gap TASDIQLAYDI:
'We'll need a CAR' → demak UZOQ.
'far' = uzoq.

lines.textEn: I know it's 8) ............ than many of the other places, ...
lines.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE EXPENSIVE.
A ning 'it's very expensive' fikrini
tasdiqlamoqda.

lines.textEn: ... but it's also more luxurious and the food there is 9) ............ in town.
lines.whyUz:
'IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
'the goodest' XATO.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'the' javobning IChIDA
(4-banddan farqli).

lines.textEn: And I've got my dad's car! So, 10) ............ we go there then?
lines.whyUz:
'SHALL we ...?' — IKKINCHI marta
(1-bandda ham edi).
Yakuniy taklif savoli — B endi A ni
ko'ndirdi va tasdiqlash so'ramoqda.

lines.textEn: Okay, let's go to the Cave.

exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Jennifer,

  We're in Boston! It's a very interesting city on
  the east coast of the USA. Boston is famous for
  its colleges, like Harvard University.

  We stayed in the Ritz-Carlton Hotel for one week.
  It had excellent service, but it was quite
  expensive. Now we are at the Bertram Inn. It is
  cheaper and very clean.

  There are many fascinating places to visit here,
  like the Old North Church. I took a lot of
  photographs there. Yesterday, we went to the
  Public Gardens and I went for a ride in a boat.
  Last week we went to the New England Aquarium.
  We saw some seals and a lot of different fish.

  Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best
  one so far is Monica's. They have delicious pasta
  dishes.

  Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The
  Sunflower and Filene's Basement are two very good
  shops. They've got much cheaper prices than the
  others.

  The nightlife is very exciting here too! On
  Tuesday I went to The Roxy and danced to live pop
  music. Cafes are very popular with visitors too.
  My favourite is the Corner Cafe. It's got a great
  atmosphere.

  See you soon.
  Love,
  Hannah


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Jennifer,

  Biz Bostondamiz! Bu AQShning sharqiy sohilidagi
  juda qiziqarli shahar. Boston kollejlari bilan
  mashhur — masalan, Garvard universiteti.

  Biz bir hafta 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida
  turdik. Xizmati a'lo edi, lekin ancha qimmat edi.
  Hozir esa 'Bertram Inn' damiz. U arzonroq va juda
  toza.

  Bu yerda borib ko'radigan ko'plab maftunkor
  joylar bor — masalan, Eski Shimoliy cherkov.
  U yerda ko'p suratga tushdim. Kecha biz Jamoat
  bog'iga bordik va men qayiqda sayr qildim.
  O'tgan hafta 'New England' akvariumiga bordik.
  Biz bir nechta tyulen va ko'plab turli baliqlarni
  ko'rdik.

  Bostonda yuzlab yaxshi restoran bor. Hozircha eng
  yaxshisi — 'Monica's'. Ularda mazali makaron
  taomlari bor.

  Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud.
  'Sunflower' va 'Filene's Basement' — ikkita juda
  yaxshi do'kon. Ularning narxlari boshqalarnikidan
  ancha arzonroq.

  Bu yerda tungi hayot ham juda qiziqarli!
  Seshanbada 'The Roxy' ga bordim va jonli pop
  musiqa ostida raqsga tushdim. Kafelar ham
  sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur. Menga eng
  yoqqani — 'Corner Cafe'. Uning muhiti ajoyib.

  Tez orada ko'rishguncha.
  Mehr bilan,
  Hanna


XATDAGI UNIT 12 GRAMMATIKASI:
  'It is CHEAPER and very clean.'        (qiyosiy)
  'The BEST one so far is Monica's.'     (orttirma)
  'Newbury Street is THE BEST area.'     (orttirma)
  'MUCH CHEAPER prices THAN the others.' (much+qiyosiy)


DIQQAT — XAT QOLIPI:
  Boshi:  'Dear Jennifer,'
  Oxiri:  'See you soon. Love, Hannah'
  'Love,' — yaqin do'st yoki qarindoshga
  yozilgan xatda ishlatiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the east coast = sharqiy sohil
  a college      = kollej, oliy o'quv yurti
  service        = xizmat
  a photograph   = surat
  Public Gardens = Jamoat bog'i
  an aquarium    = akvarium
  a seal         = tyulen
  hundreds of    = yuzlab
  so far         = hozircha
  pasta          = makaron taomlari
  a basement     = yerto'la
  live music     = jonli musiqa
  atmosphere     = muhit
  favourite      = eng yoqqan, sevimli

RESTORAN.
'THE BEST one so far' — ORTTIRMA daraja.
'so far' = hozircha.

  ACCOMMODATION

DIQQAT — SARLAVHALAR Coursebook 87-BETDAGI
19b-MAShQ BILAN BIR XIL:
     Accommodation, Places to Visit, Eating out,
     Shopping, Nightlife
  Faqat 'Eating out' o'rniga 'Restaurants'.
  Bu — 18-mashqdagi maqola yozish uchun
  tayyorgarlik.


DIQQAT — NUQTALAR SONI IP BERADI:
  PLACES TO VISIT da 4 nuqta bor, lekin xatda
  ochiq-oydin faqat 3 joy sanalgan (cherkov,
  bog', akvarium).
  To'rtinchisi — GARVARD UNIVERSITETI:

exercises.explanationUz:
TOPShIRIQ: XATni MAQOLAga aylantirish.

FARQI NIMADA:

  XAT (Hannah yozgani):
     • shaxsiy ('I', 'we')
     • O'TGAN zamon ('we stayed', 'we went')
     • 'Dear Jennifer' / 'Love, Hannah'

  MAQOLA:
     • umumiy ('you can')
     • HOZIRGI zamon ('there are', 'you can visit')
     • kichik SARLAVHALAR bilan
     • umumiy taassurot bilan tugaydi

  Coursebook 87-betdagi Writing qutisi:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type of
   writing.'


TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (147 so'z):

  BOSTON

  Boston is a very interesting city on the east
  coast of the USA. It is famous for its colleges,
  like Harvard University.

  ACCOMMODATION
  You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, which has
  excellent service, but it is quite expensive. The
  Bertram Inn is cheaper and very clean.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  There are many fascinating places to visit, like
  the Old North Church and the Public Gardens,
  where you can go for a ride in a boat. Don't miss
  the New England Aquarium, where you can see seals
  and a lot of different fish.

  RESTAURANTS
  Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best
  one is Monica's, which has delicious pasta
  dishes.

  SHOPPING
  Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The
  Sunflower and Filene's Basement have much cheaper
  prices than the others.

  NIGHTLIFE
  The nightlife is very exciting. You can dance to
  live pop music at The Roxy or enjoy the great
  atmosphere of the Corner Cafe.

  Boston is the ideal place for an interesting
  holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  BOSTON

  Boston — AQShning sharqiy sohilidagi juda
  qiziqarli shahar. U kollejlari bilan mashhur —
  masalan, Garvard universiteti.

  TURAR JOY
  Siz 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida turishingiz
  mumkin — uning xizmati a'lo, lekin ancha qimmat.
  'Bertram Inn' arzonroq va juda toza.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Borib ko'radigan ko'plab maftunkor joylar bor —
  masalan, Eski Shimoliy cherkov va Jamoat bog'i,
  u yerda qayiqda sayr qilishingiz mumkin.
  'New England' akvariumini boy bermang — u yerda
  tyulenlar va ko'plab turli baliqlarni
  ko'rishingiz mumkin.

  RESTORANLAR
  Bostonda yuzlab yaxshi restoran bor. Eng yaxshisi
  — 'Monica's', u yerda mazali makaron taomlari
  bor.

  XARID QILISh
  Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud.
  'Sunflower' va 'Filene's Basement' narxlari
  boshqalarnikidan ancha arzonroq.

  TUNGI HAYOT
  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli. 'The Roxy' da jonli
  pop musiqa ostida raqsga tushishingiz yoki
  'Corner Cafe' ning ajoyib muhitidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin.

  Boston — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!


SO'Z SONI: 147.


XATDAN MAQOLAGA — O'ZGARIShLAR:

  'We stayed in the Ritz-Carlton'
     → 'You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton'
  'I took a lot of photographs there'
     → 'you can take photographs there'
  'we went to the Public Gardens'
     → 'you can visit the Public Gardens'
  'The best one SO FAR is Monica's'
     → 'The best one is Monica's'
       ('so far' shaxsiy tajribani bildiradi)
  'On Tuesday I went to The Roxy'
     → 'You can dance ... at The Roxy'


DIQQAT — OXIRGI JUMLA:
  Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasi bilan
  bir xil:
     'Stratford is the ideal place for an
      interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to
      visit it.'

structure.heading: KIRISH — nomi, joylashuvi, nima bilan mashhur
structure.guideUz:
Xatning BIRINCHI xatboshisidan.
Shaxsiy 'We're in Boston!' → umumiy tasvirga
aylantiring.
HOZIRGI zamon.
structure.modelEn: Boston is a very interesting city on the east coast of the USA. It is famous for its colleges, like Harvard University.

structure.heading: ACCOMMODATION
structure.guideUz:
Ikki mehmonxona.
'We stayed' → 'You can stay'.
QIYOSIY daraja ishlating: 'cheaper'.
structure.modelEn: You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, which has excellent service, but it is quite expensive. The Bertram Inn is cheaper and very clean.

structure.heading: PLACES TO VISIT
structure.guideUz:
Uch-to'rt joy.
'we went to' → 'you can visit'.
'Don't miss ...' iborasi bilan bezating.
structure.modelEn: There are many fascinating places to visit, like the Old North Church and the Public Gardens, where you can go for a ride in a boat. Don't miss the New England Aquarium, where you can see seals and a lot of different fish.

structure.heading: RESTAURANTS
structure.guideUz:
Bitta restoran.
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'the best one'.
'so far' ni olib tashlang — u shaxsiy tajriba.
structure.modelEn: Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best one is Monica's, which has delicious pasta dishes.

structure.heading: SHOPPING
structure.guideUz:
Bir ko'cha va ikki do'kon.
ORTTIRMA ('the best area') va
MUCH + QIYOSIY ('much cheaper prices than').
structure.modelEn: Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The Sunflower and Filene's Basement have much cheaper prices than the others.

structure.heading: NIGHTLIFE
structure.guideUz:
Klub va kafe.
'On Tuesday I went' → 'You can dance ... at'.
Coursebook 83-betdagi LA maqolasi kabi
'The nightlife is ...' bilan boshlang.
structure.modelEn: The nightlife is very exciting. You can dance to live pop music at The Roxy or enjoy the great atmosphere of the Corner Cafe.

structure.heading: XULOSA — umumiy taassurot
structure.guideUz:
Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasining
oxiri bilan bir xil qolip.
structure.modelEn: Boston is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!
